name: Add PDF preview support to FileViewer
description:
# Summary

We added PDF file preview support to the FileViewer component by:
1. Removing 'pdf' from the binary extensions list so PDFs are treated as previewable files
2. Adding computed properties to detect PDF files and convert their content to base64 data URLs
3. Implementing an inline PDF preview using an iframe that leverages the browser's native PDF viewer
4. Hiding the copy button when viewing PDFs since it's not applicable for this file type
5. No additional npm packages were required as we used standard browser functionality
